svg.aria-label: POC architecture. MCP clients reach one stable URL per server at cfde-mcp.cancerdatasci.org. Traefik terminates TLS and logs Mcp-* headers; agentgateway routes /glygen, /pwb, /perturbseqr and /cfde-mcp (bearer pass-through) to the team-hosted servers, /reference to our cfde-reference-mcp, and optionally runs a stdio server. Both access logs go to Vector, which drops every field not in the schema, then to ClickHouse mcp_requests (90-day TTL). A daily timer rolls them up into Postgres analytics.mcp_*, alongside a floor-metrics collector's download counts from PyPI, npm, Docker Hub and the MCP Registry; cfde-atlas reads Postgres. No arguments, results or raw IPs are stored past Vector.
